description: MICHELIN Guide restaurants for a region and city: restaurant name, distinction (three/two/one star, Bib Gourmand, selected), Green Star flag, price level, cuisine, location text, city, region, coordinates, online booking flag and MICHELIN Guide link; about 48-50 per page (page 1 to 10). Path as in guide.michelin.com/us/en/<region>/<city>/restaurants. Via a rendering residential proxy. Price: $0.02 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City slug, e.g. new-york, san-francisco, paris, london

locale.description: Site locale path, default us/en (use fr/fr, gb/en... for other editions)

region.description: Guide region slug, e.g. new-york-state, california, ile-de-france, greater-london

name: travel_michelin_restaurant_guide
title: Travel Michelin Restaurant Guide
